name: plugin-nodeflare
description: ElizaOS plugin for NodeFlare — read on-chain data & agent-intelligence (balances, portfolio, token approvals, tx simulation, wallet reports, token safety) across 23 EVM chains, including young chains (Robinhood, Plasma, Ink, Zircuit) the big indexers skip. Read-only, no wallet or private key required.

NODEFLARE_API_KEY.description: Optional NodeFlare API key (nf_live_…). Without it the plugin uses the free public tier; with it you get higher rate limits and heavy methods (token discovery, deep token-safety checks, full approvals scans). Get one free at https://nodeflare.app/sign-up
